consent.bannerTitle: Your privacy on this demo site
consent.bannerText: This site uses only what it needs to work, unless you allow more. With your consent it also loads content from other services, such as videos, which may store data in your browser and use what they learn for their own purposes. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time, from the bottom of every page.
consent.dialogIntroduction: Choose what the site may load and store beyond what it needs to work. Each category lists its services, who provides them, what they store and for how long. Your choice holds for 12 months. You can change or withdraw it at any time from the footer of every page.
consent.noticeWithdrawn: Your consents have been withdrawn. The page will reload.
consent.objectionText: We can't see who you are, we don't follow you from one visit to the next, and we don't profile you. All we do is count the visits: how many there are, which pages are read and for how long, from which country, in which language and with which browser, and when in the day. We do so on our legitimate interest in knowing this. If you disagree, you have the right to [object].
consent.objectionObjected: You have objected to the counting, so your visits are not counted. [Undo your objection]
consent.objectionAppeal: Do you really want us to stop counting your visits? We can't see who you are, and we don't follow you from one visit to the next. The figures help us understand what is valuable on the site and what we need to do better.
consent.necessaryDescription: What the site needs to work and to remember your choice. Always on.
consent.functionalDescription: Content and features from other services, such as videos and charts, whose providers do not use what they learn for their own advertising or profiling.
consent.statisticsDescription: Measuring how visitors use the site, so that it can be made better.
consent.statisticsWithoutStorageDescription: Measuring how visitors use the site, so that it can be made better. Each visit is counted from the first page, without storing anything in your browser or reading your device's properties. With your consent, the statistics also store an ID in your browser, so that a visitor who comes back is counted once.
consent.marketingDescription: Content and features from services whose providers may use what they learn about you for their own advertising or profiling.
